items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible internal evidence work. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private, keep Woot permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization, and do not approve public display, alerts, affiliate use, advertising, deployment, monetization, or security-sensitive release. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, descriptions, and prices. Accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, privacy, and owner gates remain incomplete. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown; incomplete telemetry alone is not a general growth blocker. Analytics is broadly configured but has source-permission errors; Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not change launch state, production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, or outreach.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; storage, caching, display, derivative, and alert permissions; attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, retention, access, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Fleet compliance and data-quality disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries; not a fleet-wide legal clearance. Technical compliance reports 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown with open banner, accept/reject, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics has 39 configured sites, with documented source-permission errors; repair source permissions or collector errors and do not treat failures as zero. Revenue evidence covers one period only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission, with $0 attributed income; do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift. Security and operations sweeps have no results, so public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked. Ordinary growth need not be blocked solely by incomplete telemetry.
